主要内容: Historical biotech IPO data from the 'Godfather of Biotechnology,' Stelios Papadopoulos, indicates a record number of biotech IPOs in 2014 and 2015. The funding raised by these IPOs is also on record pace in 2015. The mean market cap of newly-public companies remains near its 15-year average. Papadopoulos collects his data independently, and his latest charts provide insight into the biotech IPO climate. Since 1979, there have been 734 biotech IPOs, with the number hitting an all-time high in 2014, surpassing the previous annual high in 2000. As of Q3 2015, the biotech market is on pace to eclipse the 2000 watermark. The biotech sector has raised a total of $35.3 billion via IPOs since 1979. While the average capital raised by biotech IPOs so far this year is within the historical range, the largest IPOs have raised money like never before in 2015. Axovant Sciences Ltd (NYSE: AXON) set a new record for the biotech sector, raising $315 million when it went public. The overall size of biotech companies by market cap upon going public has remained relatively steady, with the average market cap following an IPO remaining around its 15-year average. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Biogen Inc (BIIB).
